title: Refactor Kit Hierarchy Navigation in Semio UI
description: Refactor semio UI kit view to add a dynamic hierarchy breadcrumb, metadata display for the selected breadcrumb node, and an open-artifact button. Update existing tests rather than creating new ones, and validate behavior end-to-end.
summary: Refactored SemioKit from flat toggle groups into a dynamic hierarchy browser with breadcrumb navigation, metadata display, and artifact-open support. Extended the existing Kit story surface and added inline hierarchy tests. Verified with semio/ui Vitest and Storybook build.
